## Security Checklist (Required)

- [ ] I confirmed no secrets/API keys/tokens are committed.
- [ ] I ran lint/build/tests locally for impacted components.
- [ ] I assessed access control changes (PoLP, least privilege).
- [ ] I assessed data exposure changes (PII, IDs, logs, errors).
- [ ] I validated dependency/security scan results are clean or risk-accepted.
- [ ] I requested at least one security-focused review for security-sensitive changes.

## Change Risk

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

## Security Notes

Describe any new endpoints, auth logic, PII handling, encryption, rate-limiting, or logging changes.
